summary: Accepted in revised form as draft CCW-023 (ae3f1cb), depending on CCW-021. consult-001 showed the project-local fork procedure in CLAUDE-HANDOFF.md works (read-only, exit 0, answer captured, parent not written to); the plugin's codex-consult launcher is not used, since its fresh npx exec cannot carry the advisor's context, and the plugin cache is not edited. Findings 1 and 2 no longer block that launcher; 4 is moot without the plugin's tmp/; 3 (deterministic capture, failure or timeout recorded as no review), 5 (budget timeout, stop only the launched process, no automatic paid retry) and 6 (unique request IDs) become CCW-023's requirements. Cost is the main constraint: consult-001 used 543,536 Codex tokens, so consultations stay selective and each paid run needs the user's say-so. Untested: failure on an invalid session ID. The stale wording on inherited memory (consult-001 finding 4) is the advisor's to revise in a superseding revision. This response grants no implementation authority.
